title: Seat check-in
intro: Tell us where you sit, so the network crew finds you fast if something breaks.
fromSeat: Check in from the PC at your seat: Floorbit finds your switch port from it.
doneText: If your network acts up, the crew knows where to find you. Nothing else to do.
closedText: The crew opens it when the event starts. Come back then, or ask at the info desk.
unreachableText: Your network may not be up yet. Try again in a moment.
pinHelp: The card on your table shows it, next to the seat number.
noPin: No card at your seat? Type the seat number instead
usePin: Use the PIN from the seat card instead
outside: This page wasn't opened on the event network, so the crew can't learn your seat's network port from it. Your seat and nick still count.
outsideAt: Type {{address}} on the PC at your seat to check in there: that is how the crew learns your seat's network port. Your seat and nick count from here too.
onPc: Open this page on the PC plugged in at your seat: that is how the crew learns which network port your seat is on. Your nick counts from here too.

wired.verified: Your PC is linked to your seat's network port.
wired.not_wired: Checked in from a phone: open this page on your PC too, so the crew knows your seat's port.
wired.unverified: Your network port could not be found. No problem: the crew can still find you.
